[ Live GLSL Editor ]

Edit the fragment shader. It recompiles as you type.

The boilerplate is handled for you — a vertex shader and the standard uniforms are injected automatically, so you only write the fragment body and a main(). Type and the GPU repaints; break it and the driver's error log is parsed and pinned to the line below.

Uniforms available to your shader

  • uniform float u_time; — seconds since the shader loaded, increasing every frame.
  • uniform vec2 u_resolution; — drawing-buffer size in pixels. Use gl_FragCoord.xy / u_resolution.xy for 0–1 coordinates.
  • uniform vec2 u_mouse; — pointer position in pixels (y is up). Move your mouse over the preview to drive it.
  • Write to gl_FragColor — a vec4 of (r, g, b, a) in 0–1. That's your pixel.
